collection.title: Lotus Emira 2022 to 2026 windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: A Lotus Emira 2022 Onwards model requires a 24" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 24" blade on the passengers side and all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. This model uses the Push Button arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm. We also have rear blade for this Golf, simply click on the Rear Blades tab below.
